title: Gh reads of an outside repository use a token scoped to that repository
body:
Evidence 2026-11-18: node evals/adoption/recovery.ts --live (#1381) and krn doctor --unattended --root /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead exit 67 'GitHub App not installed on krn-works/seo-audit-harness', yet the krn-works-delivery installation 180498268 covers all krn-works repositories. src/repo/gh.ts ghApiSync/ghPrViewSync/ghPrListOpenSync spawn the PATH gh (scripts/app-bin/gh), whose token src/ci/app-token.ts scopes to KRN_APP_REPOSITORY or krn-works/krn, never to the origin of the root they read; the 404 is the narrowed token, not a missing install.
Outcome: every gh read of a root's own repository runs with KRN_APP_REPOSITORY set to that root's origin; doctor --unattended --root on an outside krn-works repository passes the app check.
Proof: krn doctor --unattended --window-hours 1 --root /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead prints no 'FAIL app' line
Files: src/repo/gh.ts, test/repo/gh.test.ts
